test.title: Something you own that is very important to you

document.cue: Describe something you own that is very important to you.

text: The thing I'd like to describe is a dombra, a traditional Kazakh two-stringed instrument, which my grandfather gave me when I turned twelve.

It isn't an expensive one — it's made of dark wood, quite scratched, and one of the tuning pegs is slightly loose. My grandfather played it for almost forty years, mostly at family gatherings, and he decided to pass it on to me because I was the only grandchild who showed any interest in music.

I've had it for about ten years now. For a while I practised every day, and I even played a short piece at my school graduation, which was terrifying but also one of my proudest moments. These days I don't play as often, but it hangs on the wall above my desk, so I see it every single day.

The reason it matters so much is that it connects me to my grandfather, who now lives in a village in the south, so I only see him a couple of times a year. Whenever I pick it up, I can almost hear him correcting my fingers and telling me to slow down.
So even though it's probably worth very little in money, I'd never sell it. If there were a fire, it's honestly the first thing I'd grab.

tips.en: The scratches and the loose peg make the description believable.
tips.kk: Сызаттар мен босаған құлақ күйі сипаттаманы шынайы етеді.
tips.ru: Царапины и расшатанный колок делают описание правдивым.
tips.example: quite scratched, and one of the tuning pegs is slightly loose

tips.en: Terrifying but also one of my proudest shows a more mature emotion.
tips.kk: Terrifying but also … proudest — күрделі сезім парасаттырақ естіледі.
tips.ru: Terrifying but also … proudest — сложная эмоция звучит зрелее.
tips.example: which was terrifying but also one of my proudest moments

note.en: What it is comes first, with an explanation for a foreign listener.
note.kk: Бұл не екені — бірден, шетелдікке түсіндірмемен: two-stringed instrument.
note.ru: Что это — сразу, с пояснением для иностранца: two-stringed instrument.

note.en: Appearance and history: how the object came to the speaker.
note.kk: Сыртқы түрі және тарихы: зат сөйлеушіге қалай келді.
note.ru: Внешний вид и история: как вещь попала к говорящему.

note.en: The “how long” bullet is not just a number but a memory of graduation.
note.kk: «Қанша уақыт» тармағы — жай сан емес, бітіру кешіндегі естелік.
note.ru: Пункт «как долго» — не просто цифра, а воспоминание о выпускном.

note.en: The main reason is the link to the grandfather; the detail about his voice makes it vivid.
note.kk: Басты себеп — атамен байланыс; оның даусы туралы дерек мұны жанды етеді.
note.ru: Главная причина — связь с дедушкой; деталь про его голос делает её живой.

note.en: A conditional at the end makes a strong conclusion: the price does not matter.
note.kk: Соңындағы шартты сөйлем — күшті қорытынды: бағасы маңызды емес.
note.ru: Условное предложение в конце — сильный итог: цена не важна.
